premises.text: Building camera-connected software is risky and expensive due to local networking, device fragmentation, and per-customer deployment burden
premises.evidence_span: This is very, very typical of many camera-related projects. The issues they came up against, local network issues

premises.text: A hosted developer web API abstracts those problems so software written once works with any internet-connected camera
premises.evidence_span: expose to the software developer a beautiful, modern, hosted web API

premises.text: End-customer tooling helps connect and keep cameras online, removing network work from developers
premises.evidence_span: Part of our product is for our customer's customer, the person who owns the camera, to help them get the camera connected and keep it connected

premises.text: Monetization is a recurring fee on a per-camera basis
premises.evidence_span: EverCam is generating a recurring fee on a per-camera basis

value.text: Developers can program live cameras easily to improve customer services and apps
value.evidence_span: make these cameras programmable, and thereby to unleash a whole new category of software development based around the live image

causal_links.evidence_span: this project was bigger than they had anticipated, was risky and expensive
We make it as easy to get software working on a camera as it is today to get it working on a phone
Their customer is getting a better service, and EverCam is generating a recurring fee

notes: Network/firewall, brand fragmentation, and laborious install folded as one camera-project pain (v1.5.1 §4.1.6). App-store ease and any-internet-camera guarantee folded into hosted API product; owner connection tooling kept as asserted companion module. Tunstall time/cost contrast and Twitter demo treated as evidence/illustration. Team Deutsche Telekom bio excluded. Anti-template: problem, platform, and pricing separately revisable.
